text: dsh-grok-build-policy 是一个 DSH 提示词插件：当当前选择的模型符合配置的匹配条件时，它会在系统提示词中加入一段工作规则。插件读取待处理选择、最近请求配置、上次使用的模型或默认模型来判断当前模型，并按不区分大小写的子串匹配模型和提供方。追加内容包括操作处理、当前回合完成工作、临时文件、沟通、格式和网页界面验证等规则；不替换 Harness 的身份和工具说明。适合希望在选择 Grok 模型时自动应用这组工作约定的 DSH 用户。默认匹配模型 id 中的 grok，提供方不设限制；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-grok-build-policy adds working rules to the system prompt when the selected model matches a configured pattern. It checks the current model and optional provider, then inserts the rules only on a match. Defaults match “grok” in the model id. No API key or external service is required.
想让选 Grok 模型时自动加上我常用的工作约定。
DSH 能不能根据当前模型切换系统提示词里的工作规则？
I want a model-specific set of working guidelines added to my system prompt automatically.
dsh-grok-build-policy 的功能「按模型加入工作规则」：组装系统提示词时检查当前模型和可选提供方是否匹配配置的子串；匹配时插入工作规则段落，不匹配时不添加。

dsh-grok-build-policy README · 中文：DeepSeek Harness 插件。当前模型 id 包含 `grok` 时，在系统提示词里追加一段工作规则。换成其他模型后，这段规则不会出现。

规则改编自 [xai-org/grok-build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build)（Apache-2.0）的默认系统提示词，只保留能在 Harness 里独立成立的部分。原文在：

[`crates/codegen/xai-grok-agent/templates/prompt.md`](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-agent/templates/prompt.md)

dsh-grok-build-policy README · 中文：运行时由 [`PromptContext::render_with_renderer`](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-agent/src/prompt/context.rs) 渲染。同目录还有两份模板，本插件没有采用：`apply_patch_prompt.md`（Codex 模式）和 `subagent_prompt.md`（子代理）。

追加的内容是一段 `<model_work_policy>`，里面有六块：

- 危险操作先看可逆性和影响范围
- 明确的可逆工作在当前回合做完，结论要有工具输出
- 临时文件放在系统临时目录，用完删除
- 说话方式
- Markdown 格式
- 改了网页界面就在浏览器里验证

它不替换 Harness 的身份句和工具说明，也不携带 Grok Build 的工具名、记忆目录或 `apply_patch` 协议。

dsh-grok-build-policy README · 安装：把下面命令里的 `web` 换成要启用的 profile 名称。安装进该 profile 的全部会话。

从 npm 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-build-policy
```

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Xunflash/dsh-grok-build-policy
```

改源码时从本机目录安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-grok-build-policy
```

装好后检查这一行是否在组合结果里：

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

输出中应有 `id: grok-build-policy`。Web profile 开了配置热重载时，下一次模型请求就会用上；没有热重载时，重启这个 profile。

dsh-grok-build-policy README · 配置：匹配在每次组装系统提示词时进行，不区分大小写。`modelPattern` 和 `providerPattern` 都是子串。

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `modelPattern` | `grok` | 模型 id 需要包含的子串。留空则不按模型过滤。 |
| `providerPattern` | 空 | 提供方 id 需要包含的子串。留空则不限制提供方。 |

两个都留空时，这段规则不会注入。默认配置下，`grok-4` 和 `grok-4.7` 会匹配，`deepseek-v4` 不会。

要改已安装的 profile，在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾覆盖这一行。`config` 会被整段替换，所以两个字段都要写：

```yaml
- id: grok-build-policy
  name: dsh-grok-build-policy
  config:
    modelPattern: grok

dsh-grok-build-policy README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-grok-build-policy
```

dsh-grok-build-policy README · English：A DeepSeek Harness plugin. While the selected model id contains `grok`, it appends a block of working rules to the system prompt. The block is omitted for every other model.

The rules are adapted from the default system prompt of [xai-org/grok-build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build) (Apache-2.0). Only the parts that stand on their own inside Harness are kept. The source template is:

dsh-grok-build-policy README · English：[`crates/codegen/xai-grok-agent/templates/prompt.md`](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-agent/templates/prompt.md)

[`PromptContext::render_with_renderer`](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-agent/src/prompt/context.rs) renders that template. The same directory also contains `apply_patch_prompt.md` (Codex mode) and `subagent_prompt.md` (subagents). This plugin does not use those two.

dsh-grok-build-policy README · English：The appended block is `<model_work_policy>`. It has six parts:

- Treat an action according to how reversible it is and who it affects.
- Do clear, reversible work in the current turn, and support claims of completion with tool output.
- Keep scratch files in the operating system's temporary directory and delete them when finished.
- Communication.
- Markdown formatting.
- Verify web interface changes in the browser.

dsh-grok-build-policy README · English：It does not replace the Harness identity line or its tool instructions. It also does not carry Grok Build tool names, memory directories, or the `apply_patch` protocol.

dsh-grok-build-policy README · Install：Replace `web` with the profile that should receive the plugin. Installation applies to every session in that profile.

Install from npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-build-policy
```

Install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Xunflash/dsh-grok-build-policy
```

Install from a local checkout while changing the source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-grok-build-policy
```

Confirm the row is in the composed profile:

dsh-grok-build-policy README · Install：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output should contain `id: grok-build-policy`. On the Web profile, configuration reload is enabled, so the next model request picks the plugin up. Without reload, restart that profile.

dsh-grok-build-policy README · Configuration：Matching runs on every system-prompt assembly and is case-insensitive. `modelPattern` and `providerPattern` are substrings.

| Field | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `modelPattern` | `grok` | Substring the model id must contain. Empty skips the model check. |
| `providerPattern` | empty | Substring the provider id must contain. Empty allows every provider. |

When both are empty, the rules are not injected. With the defaults, `grok-4` and `grok-4.7` match, and `deepseek-v4` does not.

dsh-grok-build-policy README · Configuration：To change an installed profile, append an override to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. `config` is replaced as a whole, so write both fields:

```yaml
- id: grok-build-policy
  name: dsh-grok-build-policy
  config:
    modelPattern: grok

dsh-grok-build-policy README · Remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-grok-build-policy
```
